items.title: China's EVs new Asia-Pacific growth driver
items.description: On Australian roads, the shift to electric vehicles is becoming increasingly visible. In October, EVs accounted for 23.1 percent of total new vehicle sales in the country, almost three times their share a year earlier. China was the largest supplier, accounting for 36.3 percent of the vehicles entering the Australian market.
